title.narrative: Employment opportunities increased for young women and men.

description.narrative:
The Government of Kenya is prioritizing the creation of increased employment opportunities for young women and men, primarily through comprehensive reforms in technical and vocational education and training (TVET). In line with the commitments set out in the country's Big 4 Agenda, which seeks to drive economic growth through manufacturing, affordable housing, food security, and health coverage, the ILO is providing strategic support to enhance youth employment and skills development.
The expected outcomes of this CPO include the establishment of inclusive, resilient skills and lifelong learning systems that respond to labor market demands. Key beneficiaries include youth, women, and marginalized groups, particularly in counties experiencing significant industrial and infrastructural growth. The ILO, in collaboration with national and county governments, social partners, and relevant stakeholders, is working to address the skills mismatch in the labor market, improve the quality of TVET institutions, and promote effective labor market programs.
Through the development of strategic plans, improved quality assurance standards in TVET, the establishment of tripartite sector skills councils, and the expansion of workplace-based training initiatives, the framework aims to equip Kenyans with the skills necessary for decent work. Additionally, a special focus on integrating vulnerable youth and fostering their entrepreneurship will be integral to the strategy, ensuring equitable access to employment opportunities.
These initiatives will be further bolstered by evidence-based approaches tailored to host refugee communities so that both refugees and local populations can benefit from enhanced livelihood opportunities. Overall, the CPO aims to contribute significantly to Kenya's commitment to achieving sustainable economic growth, reducing unemployment, and creating decent work for all through a multi-faceted, inclusive approach.
